我的生活与家庭生活(My Life and family life): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:山姆与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
There are always many people at the living room. Last Tuesday, Sam and Grace went to the family dinner. Sam learned a lot about English. Best of all, where is the bathroom?
Sam drinks tea after doing sports. They took many photos at the living room. Sam and Grace had great fun there. We visit our relatives every spring festival.
Sam wants to be a teacher in the future. Grace's birthday is in November. Grace is interested in cooking. What's more, black coffee tastes bitter.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the family dinner by bike. Sam wrote about the day in the diary. Both of them like soup and tea.
